fusions.name: Marsh Light
fusions.desc: Sends a flickering light that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds. Each hit has a 15% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Led Astray
fusions.desc: Lights false fires around up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles, which deals 26 damage to each, ignoring their resistances, and sets them [Burning] for 6 seconds. They turn against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flickering Double
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call up a flickering copy of yourself that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each strike has a 35% chance to set the target [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flustered Prey
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
